title: Messaging — Mux List — payload
description: List the delegations a requester holds as a principal, or those on a member DID it controls, a page at a time. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

as.description: `principal`: the grants delegated to the requester, and the session attaches on this connection. `member`: the grants on a member DID, and its current epoch.

did.description: As `principal`: only grants from this member DID. As `member`: the member DID to list; absent means the requester itself.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the requester and the other request members; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most grants to return, at most 500; the responder chooses a default (100) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/list/0.1#response.

as.description: The view answered, echoing the request.

grants.description: Grants in every state, ordered by member DID then grant identifier as principal, and by principal DID then grant identifier as member.

attachments.description: Principal view, first page only: the session attaches on the connection that carried the request. Absent when the request did not arrive on a mux connection.

epoch.description: Member view only: the member DID's current epoch, which a new grant must carry.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
